query:
SELECT 
  a.id as audit_id, a.url, a.status as audit_status,
  cj.id as citation_job_id, cj.status as job_status, cj.completedAt,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM citation_checks cc WHERE cc.jobId = cj.id) as check_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM citation_checks cc WHERE cc.jobId = cj.id AND cc.isCited = 'yes') as cited_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM competitor_audits ca WHERE ca.auditId = a.id) as competitor_audit_count
FROM audits a
LEFT JOIN citation_jobs cj ON cj.auditId = a.id
WHERE a.id = 3450003;
